# Trip Planner Skill for Muse

Turn a one-line trip idea ("5 days in Tokyo, mid budget, love food and temples") into a concrete, executable day-by-day itinerary that balances four things at once: logistics (geographic clustering, transit times, opening hours, reservations, jet lag), budget (with a reconciliation table computed by a bundled script), pacing (one zone per day, light arrival and departure days, flex blocks, rainy-day swaps), and your interests. It works forward from a short interview — destination, dates, travelers, budget, pace — and ends with a per-day plan plus the honest instruction to verify hours and prices before the trip. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the skill itself states it never books anything and never guarantees live prices or hours — treat its cost estimates as estimates. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
